proposal.name: リアクター防衛

legend.R: reactor on E5 (occupies tile, players/enemies cannot enter)
legend.u: future reinforcement pad; traversable before spawn

tacticalIntent: The objective is centrally exposed to ranged fire: three allied robots can position to block access but never receive an automatic protection bonus.
Obstacles at C5/G5 bend both approaching flanks toward D5/F5, yet E4, D5, F5, and E6 remain free objective-adjacent squares.
Two reinforcements enter on opposite sides at R3. Splitting all allies toward one lane may leave the reactor exposed on the other.
board.collisionAndLineOfSight: proposal: reactor/walls occupy cells; walls block ordinary ranged line-of-sight, structure is targetable directly; use global LOS rule when implemented
board.movementMetric: rely on confirmed frame movement types; coordinate-distance and intermediate-square legality still subject to shared core

turnClock.evaluation: after all eligible allied and enemy actions have resolved in each full round
turnClock.defenseSuccessTrigger: reactor HP > 0 at the completion of round 4
turnClock.globalInitiative: follow future global order; do not grant defender an extra action because of mission category

facilities.name: 防衛リアクター
facilities.unitBuffEligibility: facility is an objective structure, not a friendly robot; unit-only buffs/heals cannot target without explicit rules

loss.note: proposed standard total-party-wipe loss; not earlier fixed M04 detail

reactorAttackResolution.legalTarget: enemy weapon can target reactor if its range and LOS permit
reactorAttackResolution.robotBlocksLineOfSight: defer to global line-of-sight rules; no automatic damage redirection

mutualPrecedence: If reactor reaches zero HP on final enemy action of round 4, defeat occurs instead of automatic time survival win.
Reactor destruction and party wipe are both defeats regardless of subobjective progress.
No mid-round success even when no enemies remain; advance empty remaining enemy phases normally.

events.eventAt: beginning of round before any actor executes a round-3 action
events.collisionPolicy: For each arriving unit use first in its own ordered candidate list that is unoccupied, traversable and non-reactor, while reserving the first chosen tile for subsequent reinforcements.
events.ifAllCandidatesUnavailable: defer unit to the beginning of the next round; do not place on top of an ally, enemy or facility
events.stats: same unchanged base archetype stats and weapon as M01
events.actionsInArrivalRound: join normal initiative ordering; do not gain extra free attack

enemyProfiles.raider: identical to M01 reference stats and native weapon
enemyProfiles.gunner: identical to M01 reference stats and native weapon
enemyProfiles.guard: identical to M01 reference stats and native weapon

enemyAI.base: use M01 deterministic threat-aware legal move+normal attack policy, with objective targeting

targetChoices.higherPriorityException: an attack with current actor that immediately disables a living allied robot may take priority to remove blockers

unitRoles.raider-0: close on reactor by viable passable lane; attack reactor whenever legally reachable unless a lethal ally attack is available
unitRoles.gunner-0: take firing lane to reactor; maintain range and line of sight, shoot objective when legal
unitRoles.raider-wave-3: enter from west, pressure D5 side and reactor
unitRoles.guard-wave-3: enter from east, pressure F5 side; may attack a blocker who can be killed

enemyAI.tieBreak: deterministic unit-id then lexicographically smallest move coordinate, subject to shared game order

referenceChecks.lv1AttackerProfiles: M01 enemy profiles, no per-difficulty hidden attack multipliers
referenceChecks.damageIfGunAtG3ShootsReactorWithRange1to: reachable after legal movement toward F3 or G4; LOS and move legality depend on shared game core
risks: Normal attacks can lower reactor HP; killing or blocking enemy shooters prevents further reactor damage.
Two arrivals in round3 force reallocation before round4; no permanent invulnerability from holding one choke.
Facility HP120 allows multiple nonlethal hits; subobjective allows at most 30 total damage, usually about two typical attacks.
Facility defeat remains possible if unopposed enemies get sufficient total legal attacks; any assumed win rate is unverified.
All mission actors use global movement, range, EN and damage rules.

implementationOpenIssues: Reactor HP120 DEF50 and 75%-threshold90 are proposals, not user-ratified facility tuning.
Defending for exactly four rounds was adopted as high-level M04 mission concept; exact turn boundary and tie-break need common engine definition.
Simultaneous round3 reinforcement collision fallback and effect ordering require core design and tests.
Whether standing units block LOS and if ally protective special abilities can affect fixed structures are unresolved globally.
Relative initiative, enemy movement and path reachability are not implemented; no simulation of success rate.
Balance of 3 allies across alternative level2–4 equipment and two-wave pressure to be tested.
